findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_item_to_cart, remove_item_from_cart, update_cart_item · Private data: search_products · Public sink: search_products · Destructive: remove_item_from_cart, update_cart_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_item_to_cart, remove_item_from_cart, update_cart_item · Private data: search_products · Public sink: search_products · Destructive: remove_item_from_cart, update_cart_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
